Great news for Full Self Driving Supervised in Belgium! 🇧🇪

@AnnickDeRidder just told HLN that FSD Supervised will be approved in the coming weeks in Belgium.

This is what she said:

“If all goes well, approval will follow in the coming weeks. For the time being, it only concerns Tesla with the Full Self Driving system. And it remains supervised; you still have to sit in the driver's seat. That is already possible in the Netherlands, Estonia, and Lithuania. We really have to be the next. In Europe, we have become risk-averse. That hinders innovation. While cars with six or eight cameras actually make traffic safer. 90% of all accidents are caused by human error: alcohol, drugs, looking at a mobile phone, ... ”
